title: How a Godly Man Loses the Same Way He Wins
caption:
Watch a man lose. That's who he really is.

Anybody can say "all glory to God" with a trophy in his hand. Say it flat on the ground and mean it.

Give thanks in all circumstances (1 Thessalonians 5:18). Not just the ones that go your way.

The scoreboard changes. The guy underneath it shouldn't.

#faith #christianmen #manofgod #character #integrity
